parameters.name: Ipv4GatewayId
parameters.description: The ID of the IPv4 gateway instance that you want to query.

parameters.name: Ipv4GatewayName
parameters.description:
The name of the IPv4 gateway instance that you want to query.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Valid values: **1** to **100**. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description:
The pagination token. Valid values:
- If this is the first query or no subsequent query exists, leave this parameter empty.
- If a subsequent query exists, set this parameter to the NextToken value returned by the previous API call.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the IPv4 gateways that you want to query.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to obtain the region ID.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group to which the IPv4 gateway belongs.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description:
The tag key of the resource. You can specify up to 20 tag keys. The tag key cannot be an empty string.

The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description:
The tag value of the resource. You can specify up to 20 tag values. The tag value can be an empty string.

The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

parameters.name: VpcId
parameters.description: The ID of the VPC associated with the IPv4 gateway instance that you want to query.
